title: Sultan Suleiman I the Magnificent (Kanuni)
biography: Tenth and longest-reigning Ottoman Sultan; expanded the empire across Hungary, the Middle East, and North Africa. Known in the East as 'Kanuni' (The Lawgiver) for completely harmonizing Ottoman statutory law, and built the Suleymaniye Mosque.
internationalConnections: Formed the historic Franco-Ottoman Alliance with King Francis I of France against Charles V of the Holy Roman Empire.
